messages:
maria: heads up — got a bug report: after an RBAC role change a support user could quick-nav into routes that belong to a different org. apparently only in console quick-nav, not API. repro steps below.

alex: ugh. can you paste repro? screenshots?

maria: steps: 1) login as userA in org-A, open quick-nav + open route R1. 2) change userA role to admin and move them to org-B (we do this in admin console). 3) reopen quick-nav, type R2 (exists in org-B) and it opens R2 but the route header shows org-A metadata and some widgets load data from org-A's cache. toggling refresh fixes it.

maria: quick logs: 
```
GET /console/route/R2 200 x-org-id: org-B x-workspace: ws-42 session-org: org-A
cache-hit: route-mapping: ws-42->route-R1 (stale)
```

jordan: curious — looks like we merge header org vs session org. maybe the route-binding uses `session.org` before we run the RBAC sync middleware. if middleware order changed in recent PR that could do it.

sam: +1. i remember a change to auth-middlewares around 3122 that moved role sync to later in the pipeline to reduce calls. could be the regression.

lu: telemetry: we saw a small spike in cross-org telemetry last night ~03:15 UTC. matches timeframe of that deploy.

paul: immediate mitigation: invalidate quick-nav local cache on role/org-change events and add a short-lived guard in frontend that checks response x-org-id vs session org and forces full refresh if mismatch. canary the fix to 10% yes?

maria: i can push the guard a quick PR and add an API integration test that simulates role-change + route-open.

alex: also add a server-side guard: middleware should ensure `route.bind` reads rbac context after role sync. move `rbacSync` earlier or pass explicit org header. safer to fix server side too.

deploy-bot: deploy started: svc-console@canary -> revision 2026-03-20-09:04 (paul) :rocket:

sam: test plan: unit for middleware order, integration repro, and a load test for quick-nav cache invalidation so we don't regress perf.

jordan: good call. i'll own server patch. maria do frontend guard + tests. paul can you own canary rollout and monitoring thresholds?

paul: yep. set canary to 10% for 30m, watch cross-org gauge and quick-nav 5xx. if cross-org > 0 for more than 2 events rollback.

maria: PR link: https://git.redwood/console/pulls/5493 — adds guard + test.

jordan: server PR: https://git.redwood/platform/pulls/2831 — moves rbacSync earlier and adds an assert.

lu: i'll add a short eval on telemetry dashboard to surface mismatched x-org-id vs session-org counts and alert if >0.

alex: pairing notes: ensure we add regression test in e2e harness that runs role-change across orgs. otherwise will slip again.

maria: agreed. quick followup: need to clean up any cached keys that use `workspace->lastRoute` mappings. i'll add migration to zero them on deploy.

paul: rolling canary now. ping @channel if you see anything odd.

maria: thanks all, will monitor. :thumbsup:
